name: DaVinci Resolve
author: Gavin Nugent
description: Install, repair and diagnose DaVinci Resolve on Omarchy (Arch + Hyprland + NVIDIA). Authenticates once through Omarchy's polkit agent, then streams the whole install into the panel. Includes the checks that matter when Resolve misbehaves: audio backend, snd-aloop, window rules, NVENC, and the ProRes RAW decoder trap. Ships AAC Fix, so AAC clips stop importing silent. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.davinci-resolve

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Resolve panel; lights up while Resolve is running and badges when an install is in progress
